subject: Post-call recap: Trial -> Purchase path and signatory lane mapping for Northbridge
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@northbridge.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: trial scope, procurement path & signatory lanes

Hi Samir / Elaine —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap so we’re aligned on next steps and who owns what internally at Northbridge:

- Trial scope: 3-week proof-of-value (entire data pipeline + 500k token/month throughput). Redwood will provision a sandbox dedicated instance and ingest a sanitized sample.
- Commercial path options discussed: marketplace purchase (card) vs direct PO/contracting. You mentioned finance prefers PO for any commitment > $25k/yr.
- Budget & signatories:
  - Economic buyer: Elaine Morrison (Head of Data Products) — accountable for budget approval
  - Finance sponsor: Samir Patel (Finance Business Partner) — will confirm PO requirements and accounting code
  - Signatory: Procurement/Legal ultimately needs to sign; likely Procurement Director on file.

Action items from our side:
1) I’ll send a concise procurement checklist and a pricing spreadsheet showing both card/marketplace option and PO pricing (attached).
2) Neha will schedule an onboarding kickoff for the trial (target start: Tue 7/6).
3) Rishi — please prepare a one-page SOW draft for the pilot that Procurement can use as an attachment to a PO.

Samir/ Elaine — can you confirm the following so we can proceed?
- Is Procurement comfortable receiving a one-page SOW + PO, or do they need a full redlineable contract first?
- Will the PO route require any specific fields (GL code, billing contact, 3rd party vendor number)?
- Are you open to a marketplace (card) purchase for the trial to speed things up if Procurement needs extra time?

Attaching: redwood_trial_pricing_v1.xlsx, northbridge_procurement_checklist.xlsx, redwood_sow_template_v2.pdf

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@northbridge.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Morrison <elaine.morrison@northbridge.ai>, procurement@northbridge.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: trial scope, procurement path & signatory lanes

Marcus —

Thanks for the clear summary. Confirming the internal owners are correct. A few clarifications from Finance:

- Procurement generally prefers PO for anything that looks like a commitment, but for trials under $5k we sometimes allow card purchases. Given your estimate, we’ll likely need a PO.
- PO fields we require:
  - Billing contact (name + email)
  - GL code (I can give one once Elaine confirms budget line)
  - Vendor tax ID (we’ll need Redwood’s W-9 on file)
- Procurement will accept a one-page SOW attached to a PO for pilots — redlines to the SOW are handled by Legal only if terms change materially.

Elaine — can you confirm the budget line and whether we can proceed with a 3-week pilot starting 7/6 (tentative headcount sign-off).

Samir
Finance Business Partner
Northbridge Analytics
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@northbridge.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: trial scope, procurement path & signatory lanes

Appreciate the details, Samir — that's helpful. A couple notes from our side:

- Attached is a lightweight W-9 and the SOW template filled for the pilot (redwood_sow_template_v2.pdf). If Procurement needs a signed Redwood W-9 in a particular format, let me know and I’ll loop Finance ops.
- For speed, marketplace/card would be fine for the trial (no obligation to continue). If you prefer PO, we’ll accommodate — our legal team can accept a SOW attachment to the PO.
- Neha will send a calendar invite for the kickoff.

Internal note to Neha / Rishi: please prep the SOW and the onboarding runbook. Also flag upsell anchor points in the trial plan (latency SLAs, KV cache savings, expected token economics).

Thanks —
Marcus
From: Elaine Morrison <elaine.morrison@northbridge.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@northbridge.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: trial scope, procurement path & signatory lanes

Marcus / Samir —

Confirmed on budget and timeline. Quick answers: 

- Budget owner: Elaine Morrison (Data Products) — I can sign off on the spend for the pilot.
- Finance sponsor: Samir will assign GL code 5207-ENG for the pilot.
- Procurement: please route PO to procurement@northbridge.ai and include the one-page SOW as an attachment. We do not require a fully executed master services agreement for a pilot under $30k.
- Signatory: Procurement Director (procurement@northbridge.ai) will sign the PO. If anything changes, I’ll escalate.

Marketplace option: acceptable if you need to accelerate start, but please mirror the same scope & tax treatment so we can compare.

Next steps for Redwood: send final SOW + PO template fields; Samir, please provide GL code in a reply and procurement will issue PO within 3 business days after receiving SOW + vendor info.

Elaine Morrison
Head of Data Products | Northbridge Analytics
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Morrison <elaine.morrison@northbridge.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@northbridge.ai>

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: trial scope, procurement path & signatory lanes

Great — appreciate the confirm, Elaine. Summary and immediate next steps: 

1) Redwood to send final SOW (attached) + vendor W-9 + pricing workbook (attached).
2) Samir to reply with GL code (Samir: can you drop that in this thread?); procurement will issue PO within ~3 business days after SOW/W-9 received.
3) If Procurement needs speed, we’re happy to accept a card for the trial and convert to PO for any committed term.
4) Neha will send kickoff invite for 7/6 and include the technical onboarding checklist.

I’ve attached the SOW and pricing workbook here again: redwood_sow_template_v2.pdf, redwood_trial_pricing_v1.xlsx, northbridge_procurement_checklist.xlsx

Deal link / info for internal ops: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/NB-2027-061

If there are no blockers I’ll hand off to CS for trial provisioning Monday.

Thanks all —
